name: 大师兄
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=大师兄
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = sdk.alibaba.com.ailbaba.me, adservice.sigmob.cn

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/sdk\.alibaba\.com\.ailbaba\.me\/xgapp\.php\/v\d\/version/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/sdk\.alibaba\.com\.ailbaba\.me\/xgapp\.php\/v\d\/advert\?position=[^2]+/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/sdk\.alibaba\.com\.ailbaba\.me\/xgapp\.php\/v\d\/top_notice\?/i then reject(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/sdk\.alibaba\.com\.ailbaba\.me\/(dsx|xgapp)\.php\/v\d\/(top_notice\?|version|advert\?position=[^2]+)/i then reject(200)
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/adservice\.sigmob\.cn\/extconfig/i then response.body.replace(/false/, "true")
